blurb: Studio Players is an organization that is comprised entirely of volunteers. There is no required experience to join us. We welcome newcomers. Some of us caught the theatre bug in high school and others discovered the joy of theatre after retirement. Some of our members have a background in professional performing arts, but many do not.
